story: A lead tied into a contract until March: never a hand-over (LOCK_IN is not a contract-terms question) and never pressure. The engine waits, and the dated NOT_NOW it records (resume ~6 weeks before the renewal, signals.ts lockInReconnectAt) plans the reconnect through the re-engagement triggers.

turns.lead: We're tied into a contract with our IT company until March so can't do anything yet.

candidate.text: Makes sense. Would it help if I got back in touch in January, so you've time to compare before March?
